method.method_draft: First describe the image: read two horizontal parallel boundary lines, with three gray strips labelled 1, 2, and 3 joining the upper line to the lower line. The top horizontal span of each strip is marked as the same length a; strip 1 is vertical, strip 2 is slanted, and strip 3 is bent but still has matching left/right boundaries at the same horizontal separation. Let h be the perpendicular distance between the two parallel lines. Use horizontal slicing: at any height between the two parallel lines, each strip intersects that horizontal level in a segment of length a.
